_doc: All knobs are config, not code: outcome classes, winner filtering,
per-game weighting and value supervision can change without
outcome_classes: which replay_outcomes.jsonl.gz classes to include.
Default: explicit only (leader death / surrender), per user
inferred_ratio_max) can be added later without rebuilding stats.
policy_winners_only: policy CE trains on the winning side's actions
only. The LOSING side's states still contribute value supervision
(value_from_outcome), which is where loser data earns its keep.
per_game_weight: each GAME contributes equally to the gradient
value_from_outcome_weight: weight of the C51 value CE against the
game outcome (+1 winner-side states / -1 loser-side states).
holdout_fraction: games (not pairs) held out for eval curves.
